raw.query: WITH per_n AS (SELECT total_images, COUNT(*) AS factorings_tested, COUNT(DISTINCT predicted_ms) AS distinct_latencies, MIN(predicted_ms) AS min_ms, MAX(predicted_ms) AS max_ms, MAX(ABS(delta_vs_ref_ms)) AS max_abs_delta_ms, BOOL_AND(batch_size * images_per_request = total_images) AS valid_factorings FROM provenance.encoder_factoring_probe GROUP BY total_images) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE factorings_tested > 1) AS totals_with_multiple_factorings, ARRAY_AGG(total_images ORDER BY total_images) FILTER (WHERE factorings_tested > 1) AS tested_totals, MAX(factorings_tested) AS max_factorings_for_any_total, BOOL_AND(distinct_latencies = 1 AND max_abs_delta_ms <= 0.000001 AND valid_factorings) FILTER (WHERE factorings_tested > 1) AS invariance_holds_for_tested_totals, JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('total_images', total_images, 'factorings_tested', factorings_tested, 'distinct_latencies', distinct_latencies, 'min_ms', min_ms, 'max_ms', max_ms, 'max_abs_delta_ms', max_abs_delta_ms) ORDER BY total_images) AS breakdown FROM per_n
